name: Amino Yaeko
source:
Mama Club member.

She is a housewife and has a son. Her young looks make her look like a sister when she and her son stand side by side.

She is the oldest member in the club. She suffers from sore muscles after strenuous exercise.

She enjoys baking sweets and hates housework (cleaning and laundry).

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmc3.html]official site[/url]]
